newsitem.title: USA: Countrywide Credit Industries to Acquire Leshner.
newsitem.headline: Countrywide Credit Industries to Acquire Leshner.

text.p: Countrywide Credit Industries Inc said Thursday it agreed to buy all of the outstanding common stock of Leshner Financial Inc (LFI) in exchange for newly issued Countrywide Credit stock.

The value of the CCR common stock to be issued in this transaction is approximately $16 million, subject to an upward adjustment of up to $2.5 million if certain performance goals are met over the next five years.
LFI operates through its subsidiaries as a broker-dealer, an investment advisor and fund manager.
It currently has approximately $1.1 billion in funds under management and services accounts aggregating over $7 billion for other fund management companies.
